As of 2026-11-02: SAVE has ended (court order, March 2026) and servicers are moving SAVE borrowers with 90-day notices; RAP is open; PAYE and ICR end no later than July 1, 2028, when remaining borrowers go to RAP or IBR. Upcoming dates: 2026-12-31, 2027-07-01, 2028-06-30, 2028-07-01.

General information, not financial or legal advice. Your servicer computes the official payment from your certified income and loan records. Use the StudentAid.gov Loan Simulator to confirm.

events.event: P.L. 119-21 (One Big Beautiful Bill Act, H.R. 1) enacted. IBR changes take effect: the partial financial hardship test is removed (IBR payment is 15% of AGI over 150% of the poverty line, capped at the 10-year standard amount).
A court order ended the SAVE Plan (per StudentAid.gov). SAVE borrowers must pick another plan.
Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP) opens. It applies to Direct Loans disbursed at any time, except Parent PLUS loans and consolidation loans that repaid them.

New loans (including consolidation loans) made on or after this date can be repaid only under the Tiered Standard plan or RAP. A borrower who has any such loan must repay all Direct Loans under the same chosen plan. Old Standard, Graduated, Extended, IBR and ICR options apply only to loans made before July 1, 2026 to borrowers with no newer loan.
events.who: Anyone borrowing on or after July 1, 2026

events.event: Graduate PLUS ends for new borrowers. New annual and aggregate caps for graduate, professional and Parent PLUS loans and the $257,500 lifetime cap begin (interim exception for students already enrolled with a loan on June 30, 2026).

Servicers began sending 90-day notices to SAVE borrowers, in groups. After 90 days a final 30-day notice follows. Example from StudentAid.gov: a notice on July 1, 2026 meant a Sept. 29, 2026 deadline. Borrowers who do not choose are placed in the Standard plan (no loan on or after July 1, 2026) or the Tiered Standard plan (a newer loan has entered repayment).

StudentAid.gov says servicers will notify every SAVE borrower before the end of 2026, and that eligible borrowers enrolled in auto pay by Dec. 31, 2026 get a 1% interest rate reduction through June 30, 2028.

For loans made on or after this date: no unemployment or economic hardship deferment, and discretionary forbearance is capped at 9 months in any 24-month period. Defaulted borrowers may rehabilitate twice instead of once, and the minimum rehabilitation payment on newer Direct Loans is $10.
events.who: Borrowers of loans made on or after July 1, 2027; defaulted borrowers

events.event: Last day a Parent PLUS consolidation loan can be in ICR or another income-driven plan to keep IBR access later (StudentAid.gov: make at least one payment under ICR before July 1, 2028). Income contingent plans (ICR, PAYE, SAVE) are available only before this date.

ICR authority is repealed. Every borrower still in an income contingent plan (ICR, PAYE) must have chosen RAP, IBR or another available plan and starts paying under it. Borrowers who do not choose are placed in RAP (or IBR if their loans cannot use RAP).

next_event.event: StudentAid.gov says servicers will notify every SAVE borrower before the end of 2026, and that eligible borrowers enrolled in auto pay by Dec. 31, 2026 get a 1% interest rate reduction through June 30, 2028.

plan_status.SAVE: Ended by court order in March 2026. Borrowers are being moved to other plans by servicer notice (90 days plus a final 30-day notice).
plan_status.PAYE: Available only for Direct Loans disbursed before July 1, 2026; ends no later than July 1, 2028.
plan_status.ICR: Available only for Direct Loans disbursed before July 1, 2026; ends no later than July 1, 2028. The statutory repeal is effective July 1, 2028.
plan_status.IBR: Stays. Direct and FFEL loans disbursed before July 1, 2026. No partial financial hardship requirement since July 4, 2025.
plan_status.RAP: Open since July 1, 2026 for Direct Loans disbursed at any time, except Parent PLUS and consolidation loans that repaid Parent PLUS. 30-year (360 qualifying payments) horizon.
plan_status.Tiered_Standard: For borrowers with any loan made on or after July 1, 2026: 10, 15, 20 or 25 years by balance. Does not count for PSLF.
plan_status.Standard_Graduated_Extended: Only for borrowers whose loans were all disbursed before July 1, 2026.
